source_analysis.skill: Identify pivot columns by locating the first nonzero entry in each nonzero row of an already row-echelon-form matrix.
reasoning_steps: Locate each nonzero row's leading entry.
Select exactly those columns using the supplied checkbox or radio bank.
invariants: Matrices are already in row echelon form.
Answers and solutions must follow the displayed leading entries.
Preserve the captured response formats and easy visual workload.
permitted_variations: Vary eligible pivot positions, rank and zero-row count.
Vary nonzero pivot values and trailing entries.
Vary qualifying column subsets and radio answer positions.
